title: One
body:
A moment of loneliness on a balcony of a village house near Sitia, where nothing but natural sounds could be heard, was enough for me to realize that I have solemnly taken part in an eternal, global feast. 

Opposite me to a pole of PPC, I observe a samosa silently, patiently and with absolute dedication lurking behind an unidentified insect that is heading upwards, probably looking for its evening meal, while I feel that I am receiving a persistent raid of mosquitoes and gnats with the permanent goal of my sweetest blood that I just charged with the sugar of the fruit drink that happened to be in the refrigerator, at the same time I am trying to clean a firiki that I found on the kitchen counter and finally I abandoned because I found that it had a hole from a worm that apparently had discovered it before me.

And so, comrades, imperfect creation moves. You're always chasing something you're missing and the other person has it. And this happens in the context of a perpetual viciousness, which makes me wonder: if we were One, would we find our fullness, thus escaping the pain of need? Or does this condition clearly prove that all is One? 
And I'm talking about the Co-Pan.
85 — m
